description: Rootless container egress to the Python package index, used by rpi-omt-client's gate toolbox while it installs tests/requirements-dev.txt into its virtualenv. Two hosts only: pypi.org serves the index and files.pythonhosted.org serves the wheels it redirects to. A pip install from any other index still prompts, which is the check that a requirements file has not grown an --extra-index-url.
name: 081-omarchy-allow-container-egress-to-python-packages
